limitations: Requires a homogeneous quadratic Euclidean-energy-preserving cyclically equivariant nonlinearity with uniform damping and forcing. No quantitative critical decay rate or post-bifurcation classification is claimed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the closest published strict-interior theorem was checked through an accessible manuscript copy because the final publisher full text was not fully accessible.
provenance: Analytic quadratic-energy, polarization, LaSalle-invariance, circulant spectral, and Fourier arguments for energy-preserving Lorenz-96-type flows.
record_title: Exact closed global-stability window for energy-preserving Lorenz-96-type systems
